name: Apoptosome-mediated caspase activation after mitochondrial factor release
rationale: All members cover release of apoptotic factors from mitochondria and apoptosome-driven caspase activation, whereas the confusables cover the upstream BCL-2/BH3-only control of outer membrane permeabilization.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: stem cell homeostasis in bone marrow
name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and bone marrow hemopoiesis
rationale: Members concern hematopoietic stem cell division, proliferation, homeostasis and early progenitor fate in bone marrow, unlike the confusables, which centre on myeloid, granulocyte, erythroid and RUNX1-driven lineage differentiation.

core: Coronavirus protein synthesis in host cells
qualifier: replicase translation and host translation modulation
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation modulation
rationale: All members describe SARS-CoV replicase polyprotein translation and maturation and viral control of host translation, distinct from structural-protein maturation, genome replication and interferon-response confusables.

name: Apoptotic cell phosphatidylserine exposure and efferocytosis
rationale: Members cover phospholipid scrambling and PS exposure, blebbing and shrinkage of dying cells and their recognition and engulfment, whereas confusables cover general phospholipid translocation or scavenger-receptor uptake of lipoproteins.

qualifier: coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis and VWF-mediated platelet adhesion
name: Coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis and VWF-mediated platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span clotting factor activation and its inherited defects, fibrin formation and dissolution, and VWF/collagen platelet adhesion, while the confusables are platelet GPCR agonist and integrin signalling sets.

qualifier: histone and DNA methylation, acetylation and BAF remodeling
name: Histone modification, DNA methylation and BAF chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members are histone and protein methylation/acetylation, DNA methylation-based silencing (imprinting, X inactivation) and BAF/CHD/NuRD remodeling complexes, beyond the confusables' nucleosome assembly, SUMOylation or single-factor regulation.

name: Apolipoprotein A-I-driven nascent HDL particle assembly
rationale: All members concern ABCA1/apoA-I lipidation forming new HDL particles in response to cellular cholesterol, distinct from confusables on HDL/LDL remodeling, foam cells and efflux regulation.

qualifier: from receptor activation to TCF target genes
name: Canonical Wnt signaling from receptor to TCF target genes
rationale: Members cover FZD/LRP5/RNF43 receptor-level control, DVL activation, AXIN turnover and TCF/LEF transcription, whereas confusables are Notch signaling or the beta-catenin phosphorylation and DVL-degradation subsets.

name: Kidney development: ureteric bud, nephron and glomerulus
rationale: Members describe intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme, nephron segment and glomerular development, distinguishing them from the lung, mammary, prostate and gland branching-organ confusables.

qualifier: polymerase switching, error-prone translesion and long-patch excision repair
name: Polymerase switching and gap-filling DNA synthesis in replication and repair
rationale: Members share DNA polymerase-driven synthesis steps (primer synthesis, strand elongation, flap removal, long-patch BER, error-prone TLS, somatic hypermutation), whereas confusables centre on nucleotide-excision repair incision and error-free POLH bypass.

name: TNF-family/NF-kappaB signaling in ectodermal dysplasia and placode formation
rationale: Members link TNF-family receptor binding and IKBKG/IkBA defects causing ectodermal dysplasia to ectodermal differentiation and hair placode formation, unlike confusables on hair cycle, skin appendages or tooth development.

name: Vitamin D activation, catabolism and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern calciferol hydroxylation by CYP27B1/CYP24A1, their deficiency disorders and VDR signaling, distinct from phosphate/FGF23-Klotho and vitamin K confusables.

qualifier: MYC-driven Pol I/III transcription and translation initiation
name: MYC-driven rRNA/tRNA transcription, ribosome biogenesis and translation initiation
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I and III transcription, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly and cap-dependent translation initiation with MYC target signatures, while confusables cover RNA decay, splicing and Pol II elongation.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation with protein acetylation and redox response, distinguishing the theme from refolding/UPRmt, histone acetylation and stress granule confusables.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling and degranulation
rationale: Members are thrombin PAR, ADP P2Y, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling, cytoskeletal change and granule release in platelets, whereas confusables emphasize VWF/collagen adhesion, coagulation or integrin/Rap1 signaling.

qualifier: circadian rhythm and pancreatic beta cells
name: bHLH-PAS transcription factors in circadian rhythm and beta cells
rationale: Members center on CLOCK/BMAL1/NPAS2 and NPAS4 transcription with clock-dependent outputs (locomotor rhythm, beta cell development and proliferation, secretory functions such as lactation), unlike confusables on PGC-1alpha metabolism, gluconeogenesis or sleep.

qualifier: receptor signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen
name: Insulin receptor signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen
rationale: Members cover IRS/AKT2 signaling, receptor recycling and attenuation, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, whereas confusables address insulin secretion, glucokinase and exocytosis.

name: RAC-subfamily (RAC1-3, RHOG) GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the RAC1, RAC2, RAC3 and RHOG GTPase cycles plus generic small GTPase and G beta:gamma-CDC42 signaling, distinguishing them from RHOA/CDC42-family cycles and downstream WAVE/actin effector confusables.

qualifier: osteoblast, intramembranous bone and joint formation
name: Osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification and skeletal joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover osteoblast development and RUNX2 control, direct ossification, trabecular bone, cranial sutures, joints and tendon, unlike confusables on osteoblast proliferation/differentiation regulation or chondrocyte and endochondral programmes.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib inhibitory recognition
name: NK cell regulation by KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members concern NK cell signatures with KIR genes, MHC class Ib presentation, protection from and negative regulation of NK activity, and NK effector outputs, whereas confusables emphasize activating NK receptors and T cell cytotoxicity.

name: T cell activation and differentiation, including thymocyte stages
rationale: Members are mostly T cell activation and development signatures (double-positive thymocytes, CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation, IL2/IL7/TCR network), distinct from confusables on proximal TCR/CD28 signaling and thymic selection.

name: Magnesium ion transport and protein oligomerization
rationale: Members are magnesium transport and response plus protein tetramer/hexamer assembly, as of oligomeric transporter subunits, differing from the confusables' inositol, aquaporin, tight junction and cation-chloride transport.

name: Lactate/pyruvate monocarboxylate and renal organic ion transport
rationale: Members cover proton-coupled monocarboxylate transport with basigin, alpha-ketoglutarate/sulphate carriers and organic cation/anion transport in proximal tubule, whereas confusables are TCA intermediate, carnitine or choline transport.

qualifier: bile acid metabolism and lipoprotein assembly
name: Bile acid metabolism, intestinal lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, signaling and enterohepatic transport, sterol and dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, distinct from xenobiotic/bilirubin transport and plasma lipoprotein remodeling/clearance confusables.

name: Lung branching morphogenesis, mesenchyme and trachea development
rationale: All members concern lung bud branching, lung mesenchyme and epithelial proliferation, lobe, vasculature and tracheal formation, unlike salivary/limb epithelial-mesenchymal confusables and the alveolar pneumocyte confusable.
